label: PF Backlog 85
title: Test env: PDF generator needs libgobject-2.0-0 (test_pdf_generator fails without it)
body: test-framework/tests/pipeline/test_pdf_generator.py::TestPDFGenerator::test_create_generator fails with OSError: cannot load library libgobject-2.0-0 (GTK/WeasyPrint system dep). Pre-existing environment issue, unrelated to backend changes. Fix: install the GTK runtime or skip the test when the lib is absent.
_note: done: pdf_generator now probes backend usability + reportlab pure-Python fallback (native-lib-free); test_pdf_generator 5/5 pass
